title: Inkstand
summary: INK'STAND, noun A vessel for holding ink and other writing utensils. INK'-STONE, noun A kind of small round stone of a white, red, gray, yellow or black color, containing a quantity of native vitriol

inlines.v: INK'STAND, noun A vessel for holding ink and other writing utensils. INK'-STONE, noun A kind of small round stone of a white, red, gray, yellow or black color, containing a quantity of native vitriol or sulphate of iron; used in making ink.
